summary: Petrobras filed a routine Form 6-K reporting receipt of R$39.6 million residual diesel subsidy, R$467.7 million for July 1-15 gasoline sales, and R$2.3 billion for July 1-15 diesel sales under Brazilian government economic subvention programs, bringing cumulative receipts to roughly R$16 billion. No securities transaction, ownership change, board recommendation, advisor, or deal mechanics are involved; this is an ordinary operational cash-receipt disclosure. Watch for future subsidy program renewals or policy changes affecting Petrobras cash flows, not arbitrage.
